temporal_state_chain.observed: Marilyn has been unusually quiet and withdrawn over the past few days, which is uncharacteristic because Marilyn is normally engaging. During a busy week at the bank, Carolyn asks if she is alright, and Marilyn says she is overwhelmed by work and some personal stuff.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Marilyn is normally engaging and socially open, so her recent quietness is noticeable and concerning, but Carolyn does not yet know the cause.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Marilyn’s explanation gives Carolyn a clearer reason for the change in behavior.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Marilyn is struggling with work stress and personal issues, and her quietness may not be about Carolyn or their relationship.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Offer support and remain available if Marilyn wants to talk.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After Carolyn’s initial approach, Marilyn was curt in a later interaction, which confused and slightly hurt Carolyn. In this conversation, Carolyn shares her own tough experiences, and Marilyn apologizes, says it has been a hard week, and appreciates Carolyn’s openness.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn believes Marilyn is overwhelmed, but Marilyn’s curt response makes Carolyn worry that she may have overstepped or that Marilyn is upset with her.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Marilyn clarifies that her curtness was due to a hard week, not necessarily to Carolyn, and that she appreciates Carolyn’s support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Marilyn is not intentionally pushing Carolyn away; her behavior is driven by stress, and Carolyn’s supportive approach is welcomed.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Continue showing support while giving Marilyn space and avoiding taking her stress personally.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Marilyn responded positively to Carolyn’s openness, and when Carolyn invites her to a small weekend gathering, Marilyn says it sounds lovely, thanks her, and says she would love to join.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn believes Marilyn appreciated her openness and that their friendship may be developing positively, leaving Carolyn relieved and hopeful.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Marilyn’s enthusiastic acceptance confirms that she is willing to engage socially outside work.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Marilyn is interested in building a friendship, and the bond between them is strengthening.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Host the gathering and strengthen her friendship with Marilyn.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Despite friendly interactions outside work, Carolyn perceives that Marilyn still maintains a professional distance at the bank. Carolyn raises this directly, and Marilyn says she did not realize it, apologizes if it seemed that way, and agrees to talk about improving collaboration.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn believes they have a budding personal friendship, but she is disappointed and confused that Marilyn remains professionally distant at work.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Marilyn was unaware of the perceived distance and is open to discussing and improving their work dynamic.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: The distance may be a misunderstanding rather than rejection, and Marilyn is willing to clarify expectations and improve collaboration.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Disappointed and confused, then cautiously relieved and optimistic.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Have a private conversation to clear the air and better understand their professional expectations and personal boundaries.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After their private meeting, Carolyn feels they cleared the air and better understand each other’s professional expectations and personal boundaries. When Carolyn proposes teaming up for a new project, Marilyn says it is a great idea, is glad they had the talk, and looks forward to working more closely with her.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn believes they have resolved tensions and gained mutual understanding, and she feels content and optimistic about their relationship.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Marilyn’s agreement and enthusiasm confirm that she is willing to collaborate closely and values their improved understanding.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Carolyn believes they have a positive, mutually understood working partnership and that their collaboration can deepen.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Team up with Marilyn on the new project proposal and further their partnership.
